report_metadata.title: Model Performance & Evaluation
report_metadata.subtitle: Rigorous test evaluation results demonstrating how the tuned Random Forest handles severe class imbalance.

summary_metrics.name: ROC-AUC
summary_metrics.description: Measures ranking ability across decision thresholds. An AUC of 80.25% confirms strong discrimination between subscribers and non-subscribers.

summary_metrics.name: F1-Score
summary_metrics.description: Harmonic mean of precision and recall for the positive class ('yes'). Balances detection against false alarm penalties under class imbalance.

summary_metrics.name: Recall (Sensitivity)
summary_metrics.description: Captures 57.94% of all actual term deposit subscribers (613 out of 1,058). More than double baseline Random Forest recall (23.16%).

summary_metrics.name: Precision
summary_metrics.description: Out of all leads flagged as likely subscribers, 40.46% actually converted (613 out of 1,515 flagged). Enables efficient sales prioritization.

summary_metrics.name: Accuracy
summary_metrics.description: Overall correct classifications (7,696 / 9,043). Reflects intentional trade-off where balanced weights catch far more subscribers.

breakdown.interpretation: Non-subscribers correctly predicted as 'no' (7,083 / 7,985 actual non-subscribers). Avoids wasting outreach bandwidth.
Non-subscribers incorrectly predicted as 'yes'. Incurs brief marketing call cost, but poses no direct financial loss.
Actual subscribers missed by the model. Represents missed deposit acquisition opportunities that could have generated bank revenue.
Actual subscribers successfully identified and contacted (613 / 1,058 actual subscribers). Highly actionable pool for sales advisors.

baseline_vs_tuned.notes: Suffers from severe minority-class neglect; misses > 76% of actual subscribers (245 detected out of 1,058).
Selected model. Balanced class weights catch 613 subscribers (57.94% recall vs 23.16% baseline), prioritizing lead capture.

feature_importances.description: Last contact month of the year (seasonal deposit peaks in Mar/Sep/Oct)
Customer average yearly balance (subscribers average €1,804 vs €1,304 non-subscribers)
Customer age in years (higher propensity in students < 25 and retirees > 60)
Last contact day of the month
Outcome of previous marketing campaign ('success' conversion rate is 64.7%)
Communication channel (cellular leads convert at 14.9% vs unknown 4.1%)
Occupation category (students and retirees convert at > 22%)
Number of contacts during current campaign (conversion drops after 3 calls)
Has active housing mortgage loan (customers without mortgage convert at 16.7% vs 7.7%)
Days since previous campaign contact (-1 sentinel retained)
Education level (tertiary educated clients convert at 15.0%)
Marital status (single customers convert at higher rates than married)
Number of contacts performed before this campaign
Binary engineered indicator (0 if pdays == -1 else 1)
Has credit in default (lowest predictive variance; 98.2% are 'no')

limitations.title: Target Class Imbalance
limitations.detail: The target is heavily imbalanced (~88.3% non-subscribers). High raw accuracy is easily achieved by simply guessing the majority class, making F1-Score, Precision, and Recall the only trustworthy performance indicators.

limitations.title: Precision vs. Recall Business Trade-off
limitations.detail: Using class_weight='balanced' successfully doubled subscriber recall (57.94% vs 23.16%), but produced 902 false positives. In bank sales operations, brief phone contact cost is small relative to term deposit acquisition value.

limitations.title: Test Set Benchmark Inspection
limitations.detail: The test set was evaluated during earlier baseline comparisons in the notebook before final tuning, meaning it represents a reliable comparative benchmark rather than an untouched prospective holdout.

limitations.title: Predictive Correlation vs. Causation
limitations.detail: Feature importance metrics (Gini and permutation) reflect statistical predictive associations, not causal relationships. For example, high conversion in October does not mean calling customers in October causes them to subscribe.

limitations.title: Decision Threshold Alignment
limitations.detail: The model uses the default 0.50 probability cutoff. A bank should optimize this threshold dynamically using specific financial cost-benefit equations (cost of outreach phone call vs expected net interest margin of deposit).

limitations.title: Lack of Prospective A/B Operational Testing
limitations.detail: The pipeline has been rigorously validated offline on historical data, but has not yet been deployed in a prospective randomized A/B live marketing campaign to evaluate real advisor conversion rates.
